rules.coverage_text: All landlords in Boston planning to end a tenancy.
rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.quote: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires ALL LANDLORDS planning to end a tenancy agreement to provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources.
rules.requirement: Landlords planning to end a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources, delivered with the Notice to quit or non-renewal notice. Landlords must also submit tenant contact information and a copy of the notice through the city's online portal.
tenancy_conditions: landlord planning to end tenancy via notice to quit or non-renewal
rules.title: Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources
